entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: A procedure that combines tracking area updating with other functions such as periodic tracking area updating or GUTI reallocation.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to initiate the tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to accept the tracking area update request.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to complete the tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: Update type
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of tracking area update being requested.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where the UE is registered with the network.

relations.description: The procedure begins with the UE sending a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
The network responds with a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.
The UE completes the procedure by sending a TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message.
The TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains the Update type information element.
The combined tracking area updating procedure requires the UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
